text: 据华尔街日报，美国参议院民主党议员正在质疑五角大楼入股一家委内瑞拉石油公司的计划是否合法以及是否审慎。四名资深参议院民主党议员在致特朗普高级助手的一封信中表示，五角大楼拟入股北美蓝色能源伙伴公司（NABEP）的交易在法律基础上存在不稳定因素，并且削弱了委内瑞拉推动民主转型的努力。美国在9月初公布计划，拟由五角大楼被动持有NABEP 35%的股份。该公司将获得委内瑞拉第二大石油生产商相关的17个油田区块控制权，据称这些区块蕴含约650亿桶石油储量。作为该安排的一部分，美国国务院将获得以成本价购买20%产量的优先权。议员要求特朗普政府在交易最终敲定前公布协议
text_en: According to The Wall Street Journal, Democratic senators in the US Senate are questioning whether the Pentagon's plan to take a stake in a Venezuelan oil company is legal and prudent. Four senior Senate Democrats said in a letter to a senior Trump aide that the Pentagon's proposed stake in North American Blue Energy Partners (NABEP) has unstable legal footing and undermines Venezuela's efforts to promote a democratic transition. In early September, the United States announced a plan for the Pentagon to passively hold a 35% stake in NABEP. The company would gain control of 17 oil field blocks related to Venezuela's second-largest oil producer, which are said to contain about 65 billion barrels of oil reserves. As part of the arrangement, the US State Department would obtain priority rights to purchase 20% of output at cost. The lawmakers demanded that the Trump administration publish the agreement before the deal is finalized
